fields.summary_ko.0: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) posted FY2025 revenue of $94.2B (+6%), net income of $26.8B (+89%) with net margin of 28.5% and debt ratio of 0.6x.
fields.summary_ko.1: Eli Lilly & Co. (NYSE:LLY) reported FY2025 revenue of $65.2B (+44.7%), net income of $20.6B (+94%) showing strong growth rates, but debt ratio of 1.6x is relatively elevated.
fields.summary_ko.2: When evaluated on 2027 basis, both companies exhibit distinct investment appeal: Eli Lilly highlights high growth while Johnson & Johnson emphasizes earnings stability and profitability.
